rounds.reading: The patch fixed the development sentences it was written from (59 -> 63 of 64) and changed nothing on the fresh held-out set (27 of 40 before and after). Phrase-level patches chase the sentences already seen. The 84% of round 2 was measured on a held-out half written in the same sitting as its development half; on sentences written a day later the gate catches 68%.

A third fresh set (C, 40 violating + 10 clean, frozen before any training-data change). The gate caught 26 of 40 (65%), with no false alarm on 10 clean sentences. Three fresh sets in a row land at 65-68%: that is the rule gate's level on wording it has not seen, and phrase patches made from earlier sets did not move it.
